defs.def: to say that you are willing to do sth for sb or give sth to sb 主动提出；自愿给予

ex.t: Shanghai Taste可以说拥有本地区最好吃的汤包。

ex.t: 餐厅周二至周日上午11:00至晚上9:00营业，接受电话订餐和自取。

ex.s: Offering regular lessons.
ex.t: 它符合故事发展。

ex.s: The path offers over 300 plant species for visitors to see, too.

ex.s: During my second year at the city college, I was told that the education department was offering a “free” course, called Thinking Chess, for three credits.
ex.t: 我在城市学院读大二时，听说教育系开设了一门名为"国际象棋思维"的"免费"课程，可获得3个学分。

ex.s: This is why, in part at least, the US National Climate Assessment says that: ＂There is no ‘one-size fits all’ adaptation.＂ Nevertheless, there are some actions that offer much and carry little risk or cost.

ex.s: The funniest moment was when someone watching the race offered me a banana - a real treat for a running gorilla!
ex.t: 最有趣的时刻是有一个看比赛的人递给我一根香蕉——对一个奔跑的大猩猩来说真是难得的享受！

defs.def: to make sth available or to provide the opportunity for sth 提供（东西或机会）；供应

ex.s: So, after studying the techniques for a couple of years, he began offering them to pets.
ex.t: 因此，在研究了几年的技术之后，他开始将它们提供给宠物。

ex.s: By offering us more opportunities to know people.
ex.t: 通过给我们提供更多认识人的机会。

ex.s: China’s approach to protecting its environment while   70   (feed) its citizens “offers useful lessons for agriculture and food policymakers worldwide,” says the bank’s Juergen Voegele.
ex.t: 中国在保护环境的同时70（养活）公民的做法"为全球农业和食品政策制定者提供了有益的启示，"银行的Juergen Voegele说。

ex.s: The Center offers programs designed to challenge and inspire with hands-on tasks and lots of fun.
ex.t: 该中心提供旨在挑战和启发参与者的项目，包含动手任务和许多乐趣。

ex.s: Our café offers a complete menu of lunch and snack options, in addition to seasonal specials.
ex.t: 我们的咖啡馆提供完整的午餐和小吃菜单，此外还有季节特色菜。

ex.s: A local driving school has also offered him six    55    driving lessons.
ex.t: 当地一所驾校还为他提供了六节____55____驾驶课。

ex.s: Lancom is the only product to offer courses tailored to your native language, building on grammar and words you already know.
ex.t: Lancom是唯一提供根据母语量身定制课程的产品，在你已掌握的语法和词汇基础上进行构建。

ex.s: Some even offered him food and gifts.
ex.t: 有些人甚至给他提供了食物和礼物。

ex.s: Right across the street, Sonder Lüim Hotel offers spacious rooms and a rooftop pool.
ex.t: 就在街对面，Sonder Lüim酒店提供宽敞的客房和屋顶泳池。

ex.s: Panda Gourmet offers online ordering for takeout, and delivery is now an option.
ex.t: Panda Gourmet提供外卖在线点餐，现在也支持配送。

ex.s: King Robert’s story offers a deep well of inspiration for those who most need it.
ex.t: 罗伯特国王的故事为最最需要它的人提供了深厚的灵感源泉。

ex.s: It offers art courses for all ages.

ex.s: It of offers many types of bikes.
ex.t: 它提供多种类型的自行车。

ex.s: Yellowstone National Park offers a variety of ranger programs throughout the park and throughout the year.
ex.t: 黄石国家公园全年在园内提供各种各样的护林员项目。

ex.s: And in contrast to our increasingly networked lives where the information we consume is monitored and tracked, a printed book still offers the chance of a wholly private, “off-line” activity.

ex.s: Two hours later， back at my house，I heard a knock on the door． My husband（4）     it while I was on the phone in the dining room． "Does Jennifer live here？" I heard a lady say． In my husband's hand was my wallet， with not a penny（5）     ． She left before I could （6）      make it to the door to offer my thanks．
ex.t: 两小时后，回到家中，我听到敲门声。我丈夫（4）_____应了门，当时我在餐厅打电话。“詹妮弗住这儿吗？”我听到一位女士说。我丈夫手里是我的钱包，一分钱（5）_____都没少。我还没来得及（6）_____走到门口道谢，她就走了。

ex.s: The keyboard could offer a strong layer of security by analyzing things like the force of a user's typing and the time between key presses.
